notices: Theatre and dance listings are incomplete: Viernulvier, CAMPO, NTGent's full season, Arcatheater, Capitole, Opera Gent, De Centrale and amateur stages (OpenDoek) load only in a browser and follow later.
Sphinx closes for renovation from March 2027 for about 18 months; a pop-up cinema is planned.
Funding for theatre, music and talks: unknown until a source (credits, Kunstendecreet database) is found.
Ciné Rio, Kopergietery, Masereelfonds, Liberas and some poetry events list dates without start times; check the event page.
Talks outside Ghent are included (Antwerp, Brussels, Bruges, Sint-Niklaas and more): use the city filter.
Exhibitions: temporary exhibitions from archives, heritage institutes and museums in and around Ghent (Antwerp included), shown while they run. Opening hours differ per house; check the page.
